reason: Article 13 of the EU AI Act generally addresses the obligations of providers of general-purpose AI models, focusing on transparency, documentation, and providing information to downstream users. It does not impose a specific requirement to maintain an inventory of all models, components, data sources, and subcontractors.

Article 25(4) of the EU AI Act pertains to the obligations of distributors of AI systems, requiring them to provide certain information to users. It does not establish a requirement for maintaining a comprehensive inventory of supply chain components.
